name: Direction at 10:00 = 1-minute momentum (reference)
why: Aggressive buyers or sellers who have to get filled now (delta) show who is forced to trade; if their pressure agrees with the price move, the move has real money behind it. Pre-registered 2026-10-18 (research/preregistered/2026-10-18_rithmic_direction.md). All-years version of rdir_m1 (no flow condition), 2026-10-18.
